site.name: Hoosier Mine
overview: Hoosier Mine is a documented historic mine in Boulder County's tungsten district, preserved in federal mineral records and district mapping.

timeline.text: Federal district records document the Hoosier Mine as part of the Boulder County tungsten-mining landscape.

moreHistory: Federal mineral records place the main Hoosier mine entrance at approximately 39.97483, -105.49861 with reported positional accuracy of about 50 meters. The mapped point is a historic mine locality and does not imply that the surviving opening has been field-verified.

sourceReferences.title: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 245 — Geology and Ore Deposits of the Boulder County Tungsten District, Colorado
